title: AfisRecord
description: AFIS (Gujarat State Fingerprint Bureau) table schema - stores state-level biometric records and FIR links

state_afis_id.description: Primary Key: Gujarat State AFIS record identifier (e.g. AFIS-GJ-2026-004512)

linked_fir.description: Associated eGujCop First Information Report (FIR) reference number

biometric_match_confidence.description: Automated fingerprint minutiae comparison confidence score (0.0 to 1.0)

suspect_name.description: Identified individual full name from State Fingerprint Bureau records

arrest_record.description: Historical custody, prior booking events, and criminal conviction background
